environment.display: Private X11 virtual display without a window manager; focus explicitly supplied to new game windows

review_policy: One initial batched native review and one combined confirmation. Confirmation exposed a concrete loaded-turn blocker; a narrow movement correction and regression were required before resuming the same saved world. Independent review inspected the existing captures without another rendering/style cycle.
actual_interactions: Changed Forward from Up arrow to I without saving; entered a new native world with the active I binding while controls.json still held Up arrow.
Created Mika Rivers and Mika Freight Valley with spaces, the authored georeferenced heightmap, 1x calendar, regional checkpoints and approximately 5.7 x 4.3 km requested terrain coverage.
Registered Valley Transit for 20 personal credits, deposited 50, hired Ari Lane for 10 company credits, and created the editable Town service passenger route from Town to Hillside.
Assigned the owned pickup; reviewed and bought 10 litres of roadside fuel for 30 company credits, including the 15-credit callout. Garage stock decreased by exactly 10 litres.

Loaded a passenger. Initial native confirmation exposed a turn-clearance blocker; payroll stopped after the progress timeout. Saved and returned without discarding the passenger or 8.64-credit fare escrow.
Inspected session Controls at 1100 x 700, fixed Back/Save footer, and reserved F9 during capture. Escape cancelled capture; return to launcher retained unsaved I. Explicit Save then persisted I.
Continued that same loaded world using the corrected final binary; company, vehicle, character, account and inventory matched the prior saved state exactly before resume.
Used Start/resume; the pickup physically delivered at Hillside and earned 8.64 credits, then loaded the return passenger.

A later crossing pedestrian caused an intentional route stop. Pause safely retried and completed Town, leaving two paid deliveries, 17.28 credits revenue, 1.46 wages and 25.82 company cash. Released the now-empty vehicle.

Entered the released pickup two metres away; drove with saved I, braked, engaged parking brake, and switched between third-person and cockpit views. Route guidance and the north-up local map were visible.
Saved and returned to the menu, continued again, and verified the same possessed parked pickup, exact company/account/profile/inventory, position, mileage, fuel and condition.
Used Save and quit; no Terra World game processes remained. The earlier separate world retained its generation and exact global/metadata hashes.

roadside_confirmation.post_service_observation: Checkpoint captured after dispatch; cash is reconciled including earned wages, and vehicle fuel includes actual driving consumption.

limitations: Geometric prototype assets and sparse/repeated environment detail; no AAA visual claim.

Ground contacts use bounded kinematic stop/yield. Transient pedestrian or traffic blockage can stop a route and require explicit resume or a safe finishing pause; arbitrary congestion recovery is not guaranteed.
Roadside native flow exercised refueling; depleted-condition/zero-fuel recovery and rejection cases are established by domain/UI tests.
Native controller input was not certified on hardware. Virtual input tests do not establish gamepad-only menus or wheel support.
Real TCP/TLS, private company replication and cold-owner activation are covered by the automated localhost suites, not by these single-player images.
No gaming-GPU, Windows/macOS, public-account service, distributed authority or MMORPG concurrent-player capacity certification.
